action: Add a bill in the Add dialog
user_goal: I want to add this thing without leaving the screen I am on
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: On Plan open + Add and choose A bill
Check the address bar and the page behind the dialog
Press Save with the required field empty or an unreadable value, then type a valid value
Fill the form: Biller Fictional noodle stand, amount 1,200, due Nov 20, and press Save
Reopen the dialog from + Add and press Escape
Open /add/bill?back=%2Fplan in a window with JavaScript off and press Save
expected: The dialog titled "Add a bill" opens over Plan with the same fields as /add/bill; the address stays /plan and Plan is not scrolled or reloaded
A refused save shows the sentence in the dialog and keeps everything typed in it
A good save closes the dialog, returns focus to + Add and the screen behind shows the change without a reload: Coming up shows Fictional noodle stand ¥1,200 on Nov 20 and Bills lists it
Escape closes the dialog, leaves nothing saved and returns focus to + Add; the Ask panel stays as it was
Without JavaScript /add/bill is a page holding the form; Save posts to /api/bills and returns to Plan (the back address), Cancel goes to Plan

action: Open an Add dialog from each place that has an Add button
user_goal: I want every Add button to open the same dialog
preconditions: Fresh Try it household (Ben, demo date Nov 14, 2026) at 1440px
steps: Press Add a bill on Bills, Add a card on Cards, Add a client on Clients and Add a person on Household → People
On a blank household press each empty panel's link and each Home hint card (Add a bill, Add a client, Add a card)
Press Back after closing a dialog
expected: Each opens its own kind's dialog over the current screen, with the same form as + Add
Closing the dialog leaves the person on the same page and scroll; Back does not reopen it
A dialog left open on one page never blocks a page reached afterwards (the page is not inert)
